Sandbox_TGSRRTracker.DangerAutoClose: Close tracker windows when zombies threaten
Sandbox_TGSRRTracker.DangerAutoClose_too: Automatically closes the Challenge Tracker and Outpost Overview when vanilla Search Mode would detect immediate zombie danger. Enabled by default.
Sandbox_TGSRRRanchMortality.Enabled_tool: When disabled, ranch spawning uses vanilla's day 60 mortality start, day 190 female deadline, and day 250 male deadline.
Sandbox_TGSRRRanchMortality.RollStartDay: Used only when custom ranch mortality is enabled. Ranch animals spawned on or before this elapsed world day are always alive. Vanilla uses day 60.
Sandbox_TGSRRRanchMortality.FemaleDeathD: Used only when custom ranch mortality is enabled. Female ranch animals use vanilla's increasing mortality roll and are guaranteed dead by this day. Use -1 to disable female mortality.
Sandbox_TGSRRRanchMortality.MaleDeathDay: Used only when custom ranch mortality is enabled. Male ranch animals use vanilla's increasing mortality roll and are guaranteed dead by this day. Use -1 to disable male mortality.
Sandbox_TGSRRAlarmDecay.Enabled_tooltip: Uses TGSRR's Lua alarm lifecycle to replace vanilla's inaccessible per-building battery decay with the exact minimum and maximum below. Vanilla still decides which buildings receive alarms.
Sandbox_TGSRRAlarmDecay.MinimumDay_toolt: Minimum number of days after the power shuts off before a building's alarm battery stops working.
Sandbox_TGSRRAlarmDecay.MaximumDay_toolt: Maximum number of days after the power shuts off before a building's alarm battery stops working. Use 730 for two years.
Sandbox_TGSRRHelicopter.Enabled_tooltip: Replaces vanilla recurrence dates while retaining the vanilla helicopter event. Every configured month is anchored to the challenge's original start day-of-month.
Sandbox_TGSRRHelicopter.Year1Months_tool: Comma-separated calendar months receiving one event slot, for example 7,1 for July and January. Each slot is anchored to the challenge start day-of-month. Leave empty for none.
Sandbox_TGSRRHelicopter.Year2Months_tool: Comma-separated calendar months receiving one event slot. Each slot is anchored to the challenge start day-of-month. Leave empty for none.
Sandbox_TGSRRHelicopter.Year3Months_tool: Comma-separated calendar months receiving one event slot, for example 7,11,3. Each slot is anchored to the challenge start day-of-month. Leave empty for none.
Sandbox_TGSRRHelicopter.Year4Months_tool: Comma-separated calendar months receiving one event slot. Each slot is anchored to the challenge start day-of-month. Leave empty for none.
Sandbox_TGSRRHelicopter.Year5Months_tool: Comma-separated calendar months receiving one event slot. Each slot is anchored to the challenge start day-of-month. Leave empty for none.
Sandbox_TGSRRHelicopter.Year6Months_tool: Comma-separated calendar months receiving one event slot. Each slot is anchored to the challenge start day-of-month. Leave empty for none.
Sandbox_TGSRRHelicopter.Year7Months_tool: Comma-separated calendar months receiving one event slot. Each slot is anchored to the challenge start day-of-month. Leave empty for none.
Sandbox_TGSRRHelicopter.Year8Months_tool: Comma-separated calendar months receiving one event slot. Each slot is anchored to the challenge start day-of-month. Leave empty for none.
Sandbox_TGSRRHelicopter.Year9Months_tool: Comma-separated calendar months receiving one event slot. Each slot is anchored to the challenge start day-of-month. Leave empty for none.
Sandbox_TGSRRHelicopter.DayMinimum_toolt: Minimum completed world days after each slot's challenge-day anchor. With a July 9 start, the default 6 makes July 15 the earliest event date.
Sandbox_TGSRRHelicopter.DayMaximum_toolt: Exclusive upper bound. Defaults 6 and 10 match vanilla Rand.Next(6, 10), selecting a delay of 6, 7, 8, or 9 days. With a start day of the 9th, events fall on the 15th through 18th.
Sandbox_TGSRRHelicopter.StartHourMinimum: Earliest hour that may begin the helicopter activation-opportunity window.
Sandbox_TGSRRHelicopter.StartHourMaximum: Latest hour that may begin the helicopter activation-opportunity window.
Sandbox_TGSRRHelicopter.DurationMinimum_: Minimum length of the activation-opportunity window. This does not control how long the helicopter remains airborne.
Sandbox_TGSRRHelicopter.DurationMaximum_: Maximum length of the activation-opportunity window. This does not control how long the helicopter remains airborne.
